hints.title: Minute Conversion
hints.text: Convert both current and correct times into total minutes from midnight: HH * 60 + MM.

hints.title: Difference and Operations
hints.text: Find diff = correct_min - current_min. You can add 60, 15, 5, or 1 minute in each move.

hints.title: Greedy Denominations
hints.text: Since denominations [60, 15, 5, 1] each divide into the larger, greedy coin-change choice is guaranteed optimal.

hints.title: Greedy Modulo Counting

complexity.notes: Time conversion and 4 modulo divisions run in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: BFS or recursive coin search is unnecessary when canonical denominations guarantee greedy optimality.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms time string to minutes and applies greedy quotient-remainder logic.
